'''October 2001 Brooklyn Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG pre-release held at Outpost 2000, Brooklyn Park, Minnesota on 27 October 2001. It is known from Joshua Grace's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3084">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-mauled-more-than-your-mom-r3-prereleased3084/ mauled-more-than-your-mom-r3-prerelease], DeckTech (Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace, 29 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-mauled-more-than-your-mom-r3-prereleased3084/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Outpost 2000, Brooklyn Park, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections Booster Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 16
